b2-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Sound from the Street
b2-07-01.scenario: In a Budapest coffeehouse Karinthy hears a strange sound like trains, and the waiter asks what is wrong. You (Karinthy) say that if the sound comes from the street, the waiter must hear it too.
b2-07-01.prompt: Tell the waiter what must be true if the sound comes from the street.
cues: Say the condition: where the sound comes from
Say who else must hear it then
b2-07-01.target: Amennyiben a hang az utcáról jön, a pincér is hallja.
b2-07-01.english: If the sound comes from the street, the waiter hears it too.
b2-07-01.canDo: I can formulate precise scientific conditions using amennyiben and feltéve, hogy.

b2-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Paying Closer Attention
b2-07-02.scenario: At the clinic the professor asks how you came to suspect that something serious was wrong. You (Karinthy) say that the more closely you paid attention, the clearer it became that you were not just tired.
b2-07-02.prompt: Tell the professor how your growing attention changed what you understood.
cues: Say what you did more and more
Say what became clearer as a result
b2-07-02.target: Minél jobban figyeltem, annál világosabb lett, hogy nem csak fáradt vagyok.
b2-07-02.english: The more closely I paid attention, the clearer it became that I am not just tired.
b2-07-02.canDo: I can express direct and inverse proportional relationships with minél... annál....

b2-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: My Little Notebook
b2-07-03.scenario: At the clinic the professor asks how you wrote down your symptoms in the small black notebook. You (Karinthy) say that you noted them according to how they changed.
b2-07-03.prompt: Tell the professor on what basis you noted down your symptoms.
cues: Say according to what you noted it
b2-07-03.target: A tüneteket aszerint jegyeztem fel, ahogy változtak.
b2-07-03.english: I noted the symptoms down according to how they changed.
b2-07-03.canDo: I can describe criteria of classification using aszerint, ahogy / hogy....

b2-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Professor's Examination
b2-07-04.scenario: In the dark room at the clinic you (Karinthy) tell the professor that you trust his examination: if it is accurate, the more tests he does, the more certain the result.
b2-07-04.prompt: Tell the professor why you trust his examination.
cues: Say the condition: how accurate the examination must be
Say what happens as he does more tests
b2-07-04.target: Amennyiben a vizsgálat pontos, minél többet vizsgál, annál biztosabb az eredmény.
b2-07-04.english: If the examination is accurate, the more he examines, the more certain the result.
b2-07-04.canDo: I can chain conditional assumptions and proportional deductions in a single argument.

b2-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Helped Against Fear
b2-07-05.scenario: At home after Stockholm you (Karinthy) are writing the last pages of your manuscript and say aloud what helped you most against fear: the more exactly you describe the trouble, the less afraid you are.
b2-07-05.prompt: Say in your own words what helped you against fear.
cues: Say what you did to the trouble: describe it exactly
Say what happens to your fear
b2-07-05.target: Minél pontosabban írjuk le a bajt, annál kevésbé félünk.
b2-07-05.english: The more exactly we describe the trouble, the less afraid we are.
b2-07-05.canDo: I can synthesize formal conditionals, proportional correlatives, and manner clauses in analytical prose.

b2-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Method
b2-07-consolidation.scenario: In your study (Karinthy) you explain your method for facing the strange sound: if it comes from the street, others must hear it too, and the more exactly you watch, the less afraid you are.
b2-07-consolidation.prompt: Explain your method in one sentence.
cues: Say the condition: where the sound comes from and who else hears it
Say what happens to your fear as you watch more exactly
b2-07-consolidation.target: Amennyiben a hang az utcáról jön, mások is hallják, és minél pontosabban figyelek, annál kevésbé félek.
b2-07-consolidation.english: If the sound comes from the street, others hear it too, and the more exactly I watch, the less afraid I am.
b2-07-consolidation.canDo: I can use amennyiben, feltéve, hogy, and abban az esetben, ha to state exact conditions.
